result.limits: Fixed normal benchmark-mAP-best, full official Q/G, no training/selection/missing/new49. Intermediate directions are diagnostic descriptors, not separately trained methods. 512D pools and3584D relation blocks are separate comparisons; residual independent discrimination alone does not prove fusion usefulness. P RGB100 and R MS use dataset-specific losses, cached K201 untouched. Hooks only observe one unchanged normal forward, state tensors and exact deployed normal features/distance checked.
